format.note: Quadruple round-robin: 10 clubs meet four times (36 matches). Calendar-year season, March-November.

playoff.note: 9th plays a two-legged play-off against the Esiliiga runner-up; 10th is relegated directly.

format.note: Quadruple round-robin, 36 matches. Several reserve sides (U21) in the field.

playoff.note: Champion is promoted if licensed; 2nd plays the Meistriliiga 9th over two legs. Relegation: bottom two down, 8th plays the Esiliiga B 3rd.
1st and 2nd are promoted directly; 3rd plays the Esiliiga 8th over two legs. Bottom two are relegated, 9th plays a play-off against the II liiga winner.

boundaries.note: Up: Esiliiga champion direct (licence required), runner-up in a two-legged play-off against the Meistriliiga 9th. Down: 10th direct, 9th through that same play-off. Reserve teams (U21) cannot be promoted, so the champion's place can pass down.

Up: Esiliiga B 1st and 2nd direct, 3rd in a two-legged play-off against the Esiliiga 8th. Down: Esiliiga 10th and 9th direct, 8th through that same play-off. The Esiliiga B 9th also plays a separate play-off against the II liiga winner, below our floor.

conflicts.topic: Reserve teams are ineligible for promotion
conflicts.detail: Esiliiga 2026 contains Flora U21, Levadia U21, Nomme Kalju U21 and Nomme United U21; Esiliiga B contains several more U21 sides. None can be promoted to the Meistriliiga. A sim that promotes the top two of the Esiliiga will promote an ineligible club whenever a U21 side finishes there.

conflicts.topic: Each boundary moves three clubs down but only two up directly
conflicts.detail: The Esiliiga sends 10th and 9th down directly and its 8th to a play-off; the Esiliiga B sends 1st and 2nd up directly and its 3rd to a play-off. The mismatch is real: the play-offs are separate ties (Esiliiga 8th v Esiliiga B 3rd, and Meistriliiga 9th v Esiliiga 2nd), so the number of clubs crossing each boundary is 3/3 but only two of each are automatic.

conflicts.topic: All three levels are 10 clubs and 36 games
conflicts.detail: The pyramid is unusually uniform: 10 clubs, four meetings, 36 matches at levels 1-3. The differences are only in promotion/relegation rules, not in size.

Esiliiga promotion to the Meistriliiga requires the Meistriliiga licence; the champion can be passed over, with the place going to the next eligible club. The source states this explicitly rather than as an exception.

notes: Calendar-year 2026 season, finishing in November; 2026 placements are the ones reported by the sources. Sizes 10/10/10 and levels match our rows. Esiliiga B sends two down to the II liiga and its 9th to a play-off (level 4, not modelled). Cups and UEFA competitions excluded.
